title: Acceleration ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must state the ratio of acceleration magnitudes as 1:1.

title: Maximum speed value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must state the maximum speed as 6 m/s.

title: Power value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must state the power generated as 240 W.

title: Force analysis setup
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law separately for the power (F - f = ma1) and recovery (f = ma2) phases.

title: Displacement equation use
description: Important: The solution must use kinematic equations to relate the total displacement (20 m over two strokes) to the accelerations and initial speed.

title: Resistance force calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify and calculate the constant resistance force (f = 120 N) from the given conditions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All intermediate and final calculations should maintain consistent SI units (m, s, kg, N, W).

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the same sign to both accelerations, failing to recognize they have opposite effects on velocity.

title: Power formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect formula for power (e.g., P = F*v without using the correct instantaneous velocity or force).
